properties.description: The release in which one hub is one place to work across many designs: every cross-design read takes the other design by graph_id under the host's readable set (#720, #721), a hub's address is a view over its members (#722), a revised affected list keeps its acceptances (#719), and the site explains how to make a hub (#717).
